title: Moving Home Field Worksheets
subtitle: A practical companion for the details that do not fit in a budget table

pages.title: Mover quote scope comparison
pages.intro: Use the same move description for each provider so the totals are comparable. Record what is included, what is excluded and the question you still need answered before booking.
checks: Confirm access, floors, lifts and parking
List packing or dismantling needs
Check waiting-time and weekend terms
Ask about cancellation and date changes
Keep the written quote and booking confirmation

pages.title: Move-cost buffer and payment checkpoints
pages.intro: Separate confirmed costs from estimates and deposits. This worksheet is for organising information, not for deciding what your household can afford.
checks: Record the agreed budget ceiling
Mark each cost as estimate, confirmed or paid
Note refundable deposits separately
Keep one line for unexpected costs
Review the remaining amount after each major booking

pages.title: Room, box and first-night inventory
pages.intro: Give each box a simple ID, name its destination room, and mark what must be reachable first. Keep personal documents, medicines, chargers and keys with you rather than in the van.
checks: Choose a short room code for the new home
Number boxes as they are sealed
Flag fragile or upright-only boxes
Set aside one first-night and one first-morning box
Photograph valuable or delicate items before packing

pages.title: Address, services and meter-reading handover
pages.intro: Use this page as a reminder list, not as a substitute for local requirements. Confirm account closure or transfer dates directly with providers and keep dated readings or confirmation numbers with your move records.
checks: Confirm electricity, gas and water arrangements at both homes
Record final readings and take a dated photograph where relevant
Schedule internet and phone changes
Notify important organisations using their official process
Check mail-forwarding options and timing for your location

pages.title: Move-day run sheet and key control
pages.intro: The day usually goes better when one person owns the clock and one short list covers the handovers. Record who has each key set and where the vehicle should stop before the first box comes down.
checks: Confirm arrival window and access instructions
Keep phone, keys, documents and medication accessible
Walk each room before loading and after unloading
Check the agreed inventory against the vehicle
Record who received each set of keys

pages.title: First-week landing and close-out
pages.intro: Do not try to make the new home perfect in one evening. Start with safe access, sleeping, food, essential services and the boxes that unblock daily routines. Leave cosmetic decisions for a calmer day.
checks: Test essential services and note anything not working
Unpack the kitchen, bedding and work or school essentials
Check deliveries and storage return dates
File receipts, agreements and handover photographs
Reconcile planned costs with final amounts
fields: First three rooms to make usable
One task to postpone until settled
